reason: We have one iteration remaining and there is a critical bug (cross-trial contamination in evaluate_params) plus a few targeted fixes that can substantially improve robustness and evaluation correctness with modest changes. Addressing these in the final iteration will stabilize calibration/evaluation, adhere to the forward/buffer contract, and improve resilience without risky overhauls.

specific_areas: Fix evaluate_params to use a fresh Simulation instance per evaluation to avoid cross-trial contamination
Refactor AdoptionAggregator to avoid mutating state during forward; move appends to commit via buffers
Add ParameterRegistry.get_param_or and use for optional parameters to prevent KeyErrors on missing plan keys
Align evaluation metrics by timestamp 't' rather than index; compute RMSE/MAE on overlapping timestamps
Improve network robustness by catching socket.timeout in load_text_from_url
Support a 'type' field for module instantiation (fallback to 'name'); validate presence of required modules during plan validation
Code cleanup: remove unused imports and redundant pass statements
Add a minimal smoke test path to ensure a plan runs end-to-end without missing-parameter failures

data_analysis.adjustments: Ensure evaluation aligns series by timestamp keys; when ground-truth is present, compute metrics only on overlapping 't'. If none, return placeholders with clear None values.

model_planning.adjustments: Prioritize minimal, high-impact fixes suitable for the final iteration: isolate evaluation state, enforce forward/buffer discipline, and guard optional params. Defer larger model changes.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement the specific diffs: fresh Simulation in evaluate_params, AdoptionAggregator buffer/commit pattern, get_param_or, timestamp-aligned evaluate, socket.timeout handling, module 'type' support, and cleanup. Keep changes localized and well-commented.

code_verification.adjustments: Add a quick test to run evaluate_params twice with identical inputs and confirm identical metrics (no contamination). Validate that missing optional params no longer raise. Confirm evaluation on aligned timestamps.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run a smoke test with a minimal plan and deterministic seed; ensure artifacts are produced and metrics computed without errors. Confirm no state persists across evaluate_params calls.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute RMSE/MAE on aligned series; if peak metrics remain unimplemented, explicitly set to None and document. Ensure outputs remain JSON-clean and stable.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Clearly report that critical contamination was fixed, forward/buffer discipline enforced, optional parameters guarded, and evaluation aligned. Note any metrics that remain placeholders and recommended future work.
